set system host-name SSH_Server.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system services ssh protocol-version.command: set system services ssh protocol-version v2
set system services ssh protocol-version.explanation: Configure the protocol version used for SSH services.

parameters.name: protocol-version
parameters.explanation: SSH protocol version, v2 indicates use of SSH version 2.

set system services ssh ciphers aes128-c.command: set system services ssh ciphers aes128-ctr
set system services ssh ciphers aes128-c.explanation: Configure SSH ciphers for system services

parameters.name: cipher algorithm
parameters.explanation: The cipher algorithm to be used for SSH

set system services ssh ciphers aes192-c.command: set system services ssh ciphers aes192-ctr
set system services ssh ciphers aes192-c.explanation: Configure SSH ciphers for system services

parameters.name: cipher algorithm
parameters.explanation: The cipher algorithm to be used for SSH, such as aes192-ctr

set system services ssh ciphers aes256-c.command: set system services ssh ciphers aes256-ctr
set system services ssh ciphers aes256-c.explanation: Configure SSH ciphers for system services

parameters.name: cipher
parameters.explanation: The cipher to be used for SSH connections

unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.1/32.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses and subnet masks for loop back interfaces.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.2/16.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set interfaces.explanation: The command `set interfaces` in Junos is used to configure or modify settings for network interfaces, such as IP addresses, VLANs, or operational parameters.

ge-0/0/0 unit 0 disable.explanation: Disable a specific unit of an interface

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: The unit number of the interface to be disabled

set system login user client001.explanation: This command fragment configures a user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the username for login authentication and management access.

class super-user.explanation: Configure the type of system login user.

authentication plain-text-password.explanation: Set user login authentication method to plain text password

parameters.name: authentication method
parameters.explanation: The method of authentication, in this case, plain-text-password
